authorization: offline existing-response analysis only; zero model/API calls

data.cohort: existing strict DeepSeek V2 cohort without re-parsing or re-selection

fixed_evaluation.outer_split: GroupKFold(5) on source_group, original row order

predefined_feature_sets.raw_three_world: graph + the original 17 response_features dimensions; same HGB architecture and calls
predefined_feature_sets.no_input_normalization: full_curve minus relative_input_edit, positive_slope, negative_slope, positive_abs_slope, negative_abs_slope
predefined_feature_sets.no_curvature_asymmetry: full_curve minus local_curvature, slope_asymmetry, slope_difference, slope_magnitude_asymmetry
predefined_feature_sets.no_direction_information: full_curve minus positive_signed_delta, negative_signed_delta, positive_direction_pass, negative_direction_pass, expected_direction_up, positive_confidence_direction_agreement, negative_confidence_direction_agreement, signed_response_agreement

analysis_boundaries.interpretation: mechanism diagnostics on repeatedly used development data; not a new independent confirmation
